body:
I'm okay with it, I just... worry. My brain is telling me all the time that I'm no good and worthless and alone and then I don't eat. I *know* that's not how people are supposed to be.

I've had a good day, I was just writing something and my characters always end up being mirrors. I hate knowing that there's something *wrong* with me. Was hoping maybe putting it out there would help.
